decision_notes: Resolution 0.8 was selected after reviewing the WNN clustering grid from 0.2 through 1.0, cluster-size distributions, sample composition, cross-resolution persistence, and canonical mouse-colon marker programs. The 26-cluster solution preserves the principal global populations without requiring the finer fragmentation at resolution 1.0. The strongly CON-enriched global cluster 11 was investigated separately through focused RNA, ATAC, and WNN subclustering with global cluster 17 as its nearest enteroendocrine comparison. That review identified a stable immune-like tuft child within cluster 11 and supports handling it through a barcode-level annotation override rather than increasing the global clustering resolution. The focused enteroendocrine subdivision observed at higher focused resolution remains exploratory.
